description: Train the search-hub routing classifier to detect "web-shaped" queries and automatically include the live web provider, gated behind the proven cache and budget governor to manage rate-limit risk.

requirements.description: [PLANNED/DEFERRED] Train or configure a query classifier (within the search-hub routing layer) to detect queries that are 'web-shaped' (e.g., contain current events indicators, explicit URL references, recency signals) and automatically include web-search.live in the federated provider set for those queries. This routing expansion is always gated behind the proven cache and budget governor to manage rate-limit risk. Classifier decisions must be logged for auditability.
requirements.title: Classifier Auto-Routing of Web-Shaped Queries to Live Web Provider

validation.notes: Classifier returns web-shaped=true for a query containing a current-events indicator (e.g., 'latest', 'today', 'breaking') [covering test lives in search-hub — OT-P2-002 auto-route fold-in; the web-shaped=true judgment for a 'latest news' query folds web-search.live into the fan-out; the web_shaped decode contract is pinned by classifier_internal_test.go::TestParseClassifierResponse_WebShaped]

Classifier returns web-shaped=false for a general knowledge query with no recency signals [covering test lives in search-hub — OT-P2-002 auto-route fold-in; a non-web-shaped general query keeps the external provider withheld even with the flag ON]
Auto-routing to live-web is blocked when budget governor reports exhausted state, even for web-shaped queries

Classifier routing decision is recorded in routing telemetry with query hash and decision [covering test lives in search-hub — every query records one TelemetrySample carrying QueryHash (raw text never stored) plus the AutoRoutedExternal/Escalated decision flags, asserted across TestQueryRecordsTelemetry and the auto_external tests. As-built gap: classifier CONFIDENCE is not recorded in the sample — tracked in PROBLEMS.md and filed as a search-hub bug]

Issue a recency-signaled query against the classifier-enabled routing; verify web-search.live is included in the provider set and a SearXNG call is made (within budget) [covering test lives in search-hub — OT-P2-002 auto-route fold-in]

Exhaust the budget governor, then issue a web-shaped query; verify no SearXNG call is made and the rate-limited response is returned [covering test lives in search-hub — OT-P2-002 auto-route fold-in; the router degrades gracefully on the 429 rate-limited leaf; web-search's own TestServiceGovernorExhaustionDegradesWithoutClient pins that exhaustion never calls SearXNG]
Classifier inference adds at most 50ms to the routing decision path

Users asking time-sensitive questions automatically receive live web results without needing to explicitly use --type web [covering test lives in search-hub — OT-P2-002 auto-route fold-in; the query carries no explicit type selector, the web-shaped judgment alone folds web-search.live in]

title: Classifier Auto-Routing to Live Web
